#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build the release launcher at ./app (stdlib only; no packages to fetch).
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

python3 -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 12))' \
  || { echo "python3 >= 3.12 required" >&2; exit 1; }

# Precompile optimized bytecode so startup is fast.
python3 -O -m compileall -q kvhttp

cat > app <<'LAUNCHER'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
here="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PYTHONPATH="$here${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}" exec python3 -O -m kvhttp "$@"
LAUNCHER
chmod +x app

"""Entry point: ``python -m kvhttp <port>``."""

import argparse
import asyncio
import contextlib
import logging

from kvhttp.server import serve


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="kvhttp", description="In-memory KV server")
    parser.add_argument("port", type=int, help="TCP port to listen on")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not 0 < args.port < 65536:
        parser.error("port must be between 1 and 65535")

    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.WARNING, format="%(levelname)s %(message)s")
    with contextlib.suppress(KeyboardInterrupt):
        asyncio.run(serve(args.host, args.port))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
